papers.title: Characterization of Nano-Sized Features in Powder Bed Additively Manufactured Ti-6Al-4V Alloy
papers.abstract: In this study, we delve into the intricate microstructural features of Ti-6Al-4V alloy additively manufactured and heat-treated at 800 °C for 4 h. Our in-depth analysis will enable us to gain a better understanding of the β-Ti precipitation process, its dependence on temperature, and its ultimate effect on the overall mechanical properties. As well as α-Ti martensite grains and β-Ti particles interspersed in the α-Ti grain boundaries, there is a third microstructural feature, overlooked by many researchers. This feature is observed as nano-sized particles homogeneously embedded inside the α-Ti laths. Using high-resolution transmission electron microscopy, we reveal that these nano-sized features do not constitute a different phase. Instead, they define isolated regions of α-Ti in its relaxed form, surrounded by the heavily strained form of the α-Ti phase. This phenomenon is a result of the "incomplete" precipitation of the β-Ti phase following the heat treatment stage. The straining of the α-Ti phase appears as a shift in the equilibrium atomic position.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究了Ti-6Al-4V增材制造后热处理过程中的微观结构特征，但未涉及力学性能（如疲劳）的变化。
llm.why_not_core: No mechanical performance data (fatigue, tensile, etc.) reported; only microstructural characterization without linking to post-processing effects on mechanical properties.

summary_zh.motivation: 揭示增材制造Ti-6Al-4V合金在800°C热处理后纳米级特征的微观结构起源。
summary_zh.method: 采用高分辨率透射电镜表征α-Ti板条内纳米级特征。
summary_zh.result: 发现这些特征为β-Ti不完全沉淀导致的松弛α-Ti区域，被应变α-Ti包围。
summary_zh.validation: 高分辨率TEM成像及衍射分析。

summary_en.motivation: To understand the origin and nature of nano-sized features in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V after heat treatment at 800°C for 4 hours.
summary_en.method: High-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) was used to characterize the nano-sized features embedded within α-Ti laths.
summary_en.result: The nano-sized features are isolated regions of relaxed α-Ti caused by incomplete β-Ti precipitation, surrounded by heavily strained α-Ti.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via HRTEM imaging and diffraction pattern analysis.
